method: Actual HalcBoundaries and scheduler via existing project adapter, deterministic task queue and DOM/map boundaries. Layout changes are made without emitting render/idle; first high-zoom recovery, sliced cancellation, request ownership, bounded recovery and exit guards are exercised. No browser timing/pixel claim.

checks.name: First high-zoom labels recover a layout-only context cancellation before any anchor, with no subsequent map render or idle
Layout changes between anchor slices discard stale work and commit a complete current frame
An external newest-context request coalesces with canceled-job recovery instead of scheduling a second job
Continuous unsignaled layout changes stop after three recoveries, and a later explicit refresh can resume
Canceled-context recovery performs no late work after destroy
Canceled-context recovery performs no late work after year change
Canceled-context recovery performs no late work after labels hidden
Canceled-context recovery performs no late work after loading
Canceled-context recovery performs no late work after moving
Independent maps own separate context recovery chains
